notes.title: The Craziest Amphibian Arrives in RetroGamer!🐸
notes.notes:
Hello! 👋 I'm Javi, creator of Cacops, and I'm thrilled to share that my game has made it to the pages of RetroGamer! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716201/3c96d9b5bbd10c0828e72432c59271e1b370156d.png[/img]

Since I started working on Cacops, I always dreamed of reaching players who love retro games 🕹️ as much as I do. Seeing my work featured in such an iconic magazine is an immense honor and an incredible motivation to keep creating. 🚀

If you've ever dreamed of a world where amphibians are the true action heroes, Cacops is your next must-play adventure. 🌿🐊 With a visual style that pays homage to the 16-bit classics and challenging gameplay that will test your reflexes, this indie gem is catching the attention of players and critics alike. 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716201/b2237d2eca704b43cb5264c02e5561175c61ff87.jpg[/img]

I invite you to read [url=https://www.henneomagazines.com/products/retro-gamer-n%C2%BA-50]the magazine[/url] and discover everything about Cacops. 🦖

➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651910/Dinopunk_the_Cacops_adventure/?l=english

notes.title: WELCOME TO OUR DEVLOG!
notes.notes:
Hello, Jurassic explorers! 🦖

In this first entry of our development journal, we’d like to welcome you to the “Retro-world” of Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure, a game full of action, puzzles 🧩, and of course, dinosaurs! 🦕

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to live in a world inhabited by dinosaurs? Well, in Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure, you’ll step into the shoes of Cacops, a small amphibious dinosaur with a unique power: the ability to control water! 🌊 But that’s not all! Alongside facing challenges ⚔️ and enemies, you’ll embark on a personal mission to recover your egg 🥚, stolen by some evil ninjas 🥷 wreaking havoc in the world.

[previewyoutube=4MGT-oNHQe0;full][/previewyoutube]

Our goal with this devlog is to take you behind the scenes 🎥, showing how a solo developer is creating an entire pixel-art universe 🎨 while sharing details, anecdotes from the development process, gameplay mechanics, and even the story that inspires it.

So, if you’re a fan of classic games and challenging 2D platformers like Wonderboy, Alex Kidd, The New Zealand Story, Willow, Contra, and many more...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716201/23c094958a25b0a8b7d0c00a129e1e038096ef0d.png[/img]

[b]you’re in the right place! 🌟[/b]

Follow me on Twitter: @javi_TheDude

notes.title: RIDE THE WAVE 🌊 OF DINOPUNK: THE CACOPS ADVENTURE WITH DOJO SYSTEM!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716201/d57a28926fd6bba5bba628a739381dc09ca9d8d6.png[/img]

[h1]RIDE THE WAVE 🌊 OF DINOPUNK: THE CACOPS ADVENTURE WITH DOJO SYSTEM![/h1]

To all [b]#IndieDevs #GameDevs[/b] and lovers of [b]retro video games[/b],

Get ready for this epic Jurassic adventure with [b]🦖Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure[/b]!
From Dojo System🏯 and The Dude Games studio, we invite you to dive into a pixel art world full of action, challenging platforms, and a nostalgic vibe that will take you back to the 80s. You can now enjoy its revamped art and exclusive soundtrack while you become a small amphibian dinosaur with the unique power to control water.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716201/23c094958a25b0a8b7d0c00a129e1e038096ef0d.png[/img]


Discover the story of Cacops and help him in his quest to recover his stolen egg🥚, while facing obstacles, enemies, and dinosaurs under the rule of the fearsome King-T. With pixel art aesthetics paying homage to classics like Wonder Boy, Alex Kidd, and Contra, Dinopunk captures the essence of 2D platformers from the golden era, but with updated graphics and more modern gameplay.

Explore a vast map full of secrets and challenging levels, using your ability to control water. You can also upgrade your skills in the in-game store, unlocking new abilities to tackle increasingly difficult levels.

And that's not all! Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure also includes a minigame, in true California Games🏄 style, and countless nods to the 90s and 80s. Don't forget the epic battles against gigantic final bosses, each with their own unique attack style and patterns.

Enjoy the new trailer and this retro 🕹️ modern experience for all audiences.
[previewyoutube=4MGT-oNHQe0;full][/previewyoutube]
